items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Another guy hollers at me at the airport, comedian, George Kirby.

ctx.x: It becomes a small world in the world of musicians sometimes.

Sometimes I go through the airport and I hear somebody hollering, 'Hey, Chief,' and I remember the 'Loch Lomond' girl?---turn around and there was Maxie Sullivan -/ 'Hey, Chief, where ya going?' And I'd tell them where I was going, 'Where you going yourself?' They're going here and there. Another guy hollers at me at the airport, comedian, George Kirby. They used to all holler at me at the airport. Invariably when I'd walk into the airport, some guy would run up to me and say, some guy says to say hello to you,…
Passed the word on, second or third hand.
